title: Hybrid Universal Scraper
description: LLM-powered universal web scraper with pattern caching. Works on ANY website without configuration. 99.5% cost savings on cached requests!

startUrls.title: URLs to Scrape
startUrls.description: List of URLs to scrape. The system will automatically detect patterns and extract data.

fields.title: 📝 What to Extract (Natural Language OK!)
fields.description:
Describe what data you want to extract in plain English. Examples:
• "Extract product names, prices, and descriptions"
• "Get all job titles, companies, and locations"
• "Scrape article headlines, authors, and dates"

The AI will automatically understand what you want and extract it! No technical knowledge required.
fields.prefill: Extract product names, prices, and descriptions for all items

openaiApiKey.title: 🔑 OpenAI API Key
openaiApiKey.description: Your OpenAI API key (required for pattern generation). Cost: ~$0.02 per new domain, then $0.0001 for cached patterns. You can also set OPENAI_API_KEY as an environment variable.

hybridConfig.title: ⚙️ Hybrid System Configuration (Advanced)
hybridConfig.description: Advanced configuration for the hybrid system

similarityThreshold.title: Pattern Similarity Threshold
similarityThreshold.description: Threshold for pattern reuse (0.0-1.0). Higher = more strict matching. Recommended: 0.75

enableLLM.title: Enable LLM Pattern Generation
enableLLM.description: Use LLM to generate semantic patterns. If false, uses fallback patterns (free but less accurate).

cachePatterns.title: Cache Generated Patterns
cachePatterns.description: Save patterns to cache for future reuse. Highly recommended for cost savings!

maxContainers.title: Max Containers per Page
maxContainers.description: Maximum number of repeating items to extract per page

proxyConfiguration.title: 🔗 Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Configure Apify residential proxies (recommended for production)
